test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of B. Only three people sit between B and K. F sits second to the right of B. Only two people sit between F and C. G sits at some place to the right of E but at some place to the left of D. How many people sit to the right of G?
solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north. 

1. Only two people sit to the left of B.

2. Only three people sit between B and K. 

3. F sits second to the right of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0d228a3acd1ba3b2d45ae73e02532e7a04eb9572873783c5279feaec15f3eda.png] 

4. Only two people sit between F and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ea624df0ea1fb72cadd426c0c77f709e02047b06d4e048276ef5cd5202712a2.png] 

5. G sits at some place to the right of E but at some place to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a874494dc3ae5223f23e1932000ff2afb2cdb2d8c26dd7ad4acb6ac822a57133.png] So, **three **people sit to the right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Three".**
